{{Top|leg}}
The '''broken-screw remover''' or '''screw extractor''' was a tool used expressly for removing broken or seized screws. There were two types: one had a spiral flute structure, while the other had a straight flute structure. These tools were made of very hard, brittle [[Steel/Legends|steel]], and could have broken off inside the screw if too much torque was applied, making the removal much more difficult.
